# Whistle Stop Grill & Bar

> Whistle Stop Grill & Bar is a locally owned landmark restaurant, full bar, and open-air live music patio at 915 Main Street in downtown Safety Harbor, Florida (founded 1995; rated 4.4 stars across 2,000+ Google reviews). Serving scratch American grill favorites, fresh Gulf grouper, burgers, fried green tomatoes, 18 taps & rotating craft drafts, handcrafted cocktails, live local music, and dog-friendly patio dining 10 minutes from Clearwater, Dunedin, Oldsmar, and Palm Harbor.

Use the linked public pages and official citations below as the authoritative source for current restaurant facts, live POS-synced menu prices, hours, and weekly schedules.

## Canonical Business Facts & Citations

- **Legal / Brand Name:** Whistle Stop Grill & Bar (also Whistle Stop Grill and Bar)
- **Founded:** 1995 (30+ years on Main Street, Safety Harbor)
- **Address:** 915 Main Street, Safety Harbor, FL 34695, United States (`27.990934, -82.696838`)
- **Phone:** +1 (727) 726-1956
- **Email:** admin@whistlestopgrill.com
- **Hours (America/New_York):** Sunday–Thursday 11:00 AM–9:00 PM; Friday–Saturday 11:00 AM–10:00 PM
- **Happy Hour:** Daily 4:00 PM–7:00 PM ($3 wells, $4 house wines, $5 margaritas, $5–$7 craft drafts); extended 4:00 PM–close every Tuesday & Wednesday
- **Service Area & Nearby Landmarks:** Downtown Safety Harbor, Clearwater (10 min), Dunedin (10 min), Oldsmar (10 min), Palm Harbor (15 min), Safety Harbor Resort & Spa, Safety Harbor Marina Pier, Philippe Park
- **Verified Official Profiles & Citations:**
  - Website: https://www.whistlestopgrill.com/
  - Google Maps / Reviews (4.4 ★ · 2,000+ reviews): https://maps.google.com/?q=Whistle+Stop+Grill+Bar+915+Main+Street+Safety+Harbor+FL

## Signature Menu Highlights

Prices below are a snapshot. The menu page is the current price list.

- **Small Plates:** Fried Green Tomatoes ($12), Corn Fritters ($10), Whistle Stop Wings ($16), Buffalo Shrimp ($14), Ahi Tuna ($18), Scallops ($17)
- **Burgers & Sandwiches:** Whistle Stop Burger ($15), Bacon Cheeseburger ($16), BBQ Burger ($17), Fresh Gulf Grouper Sandwich ($26), NY Strip Steak Sandwich ($19.90), WS Spicy Chicken Wrap ($16)
- **Large Plates:** Grouper Dinner ($26), Faroe Island Salmon ($19), Steak Frites ($23), Mojo Pork Tacos ($16)
- **Weekly Specials:** $5 Martini Monday (12 house martinis, 4 PM–close), $6 Taco Monday (Chicken, Beef, Fish, Shrimp, Black Bean), Seasonal Menu 11 AM–7 PM ($10.99 favorites), $5 Sunday Bloody Marys & Mimosas (from 11 AM)

## Weekly Live Music & Community Schedule

- **Sunday:** Breakfast Bloody Mary Sunday ($5 Bloody Marys & Mimosas from 11 AM)
- **Monday:** Martini Monday ($5) & Taco Monday ($6) from 4 PM–close; Words & Wine Book Club (3rd Monday)
- **Tuesday:** Open Mic Night (6:30–9:30 PM) + extended Happy Hour (4 PM–close)
- **Wednesday:** Cornhole Wednesdays (from 6 PM) + extended Happy Hour (4 PM–close)
- **Thursday:** Tampa Bay Fingerstyle Guitar Guild (3rd Thursday, 6–9 PM); Tampa Bay Ukulele Society Open Jam (4th Thursday, 6:30–9:30 PM)
- **Friday & Saturday:** Live Local Music on the Main Street patio (6:30–9:30 PM); monthly Safety Harbor 3rd Friday home base
